problem:
A circular plate of mass $2\,\text{kg}$ and uniform mass density occupies the region of a disk $D$ of radius $2\,\text{m}$ centered at the origin.
Find the moment of inertia of the plate about a line perpendicular to $D$ at a distance of $4\,\text{m}$ from a parallel line passing through its center of mass.

feedback.problem:
A circular plate of mass $8\,\text{kg}$ and uniform mass density occupies the region of a disk $D$ of radius $4\,\text{m}$ centered at the origin.
Find the moment of inertia of the plate about a line perpendicular to $D$ at a distance of $0.5\,\text{m}$ from a parallel line passing through its center of mass.
feedback.worked_solution:
For a plane lamina of mass $M$ and a line ${l}_{M}$ perpendicular to the lamina passing through its center of mass, the parallel axis theorem states that the moment of inertia of the lamina about a line $l$ parallel to ${l}_{M}$ is given by

$$
{I}_{l}={I}_{M}+{d}^{2}M,
$$

where $d$ is the distance between the lines, and ${I}_{M}$ and ${I}_{l}$ are the moments of inertia about the lines ${l}_{M}$ and $l,$ respectively.

First, notice that the region $D$ can be expressed in polar coordinates as

$$
D={(r,\theta )\,:\,0\le r\le 4,\,0\le \theta <2\pi }.
$$

The area of the circular plate $D$ is $A=\pi \cdot {4}^{2}=16\pi \,{\text{m}}^{2}.$
Since the plate has a uniform density, the mass density function is given by

$$
\lambda (r,\theta )=\frac{M}{A}=\frac{8}{16\pi }=\frac{1}{2\pi }\,\text{kg}/{\text{m}}^{2},
$$

and its center of mass is its centroid $(0,0).$

Then, the moment of inertia about the perpendicular line through the center of mass is

$$
\begin{aligned}{I}_{M} & ={∬}_{D}\lambda (r,\theta )\cdot {r}^{3}\,\text{d}r\,\text{d}\theta  \\  & =\frac{1}{2\pi }{\int }_{0}^{4}{r}^{3}\,\text{d}r{\int }_{0}^{2\pi }\,\text{d}\theta  \\  & =\frac{1}{2\pi }\cdot \frac{1}{4}{r}^{4}{|}_{0}^{4}\cdot \theta {|}_{0}^{2\pi } \\  & =\frac{1}{2\pi }\cdot 64\cdot 2\pi  \\  & =64\,\text{kg}\cdot {\text{m}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, applying the parallel axis theorem, the moment of inertia about a line $0.5\,\text{m}$ from the center of mass is

$$
\begin{aligned}I & ={I}_{M}+{d}^{2}M \\  & =64+{0.5}^{2}\cdot 8 \\  & =64+2 \\  & =66\,\text{kg}\cdot {\text{m}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
